title: How an Anthropic engineer uses Claude Docs
format_note: Presenter voice-over narrates two real use cases (stand-up, launch review) while a live-typed Claude Docs capture is zoomed and panned; ends on tagline and logo.
one_thing: Claude Docs is a shared document where teammates and Claude type side by side, so Claude suggests agenda items, builds a chart and checks the author's claims.

transcript.voice_style: Plain first-person speech from a named product engineer; short declaratives, no hype words; the sentences name each on-screen action as it happens.
transcript.script_shape: Intro (name, role, promise at 7-14s), then two numbered use cases ('First up is stand-up', 'Then, there's launch reviews'), each as ask-Claude then result, then one-line invitation to try it.

on_screen_lines.text: How an Anthropic engineer uses Claude Docs
Intro / Team standups / Launch reviews / Outro
Charts and diagrams launched last month. People use them more than expected, and most docs with a chart or diagram get shared.
Docs with a visual grew every week
Mostly. For: docs with a data chart get shared more often than docs without one. Against: docs with only a diagram get shared less often.
@Claude are data charts still growing or leveling off? Leveling off. Flat from week 3 to week 4.
Claude makes it. You steer it.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: The 26-word Claude reply holds about 3 s where the rule asks 8.3 s, so voice-over carries it; the 6-word tagline needs 2.3 s and holds about 1.5 s after typing.

good.observation: The product does the animating: named cursors type real-looking stand-up updates at once, so the viewer sees collaboration instead of being told about it.
Each use case follows one pattern, ask Claude, see the result, in 10-20 s, so the film is easy to follow and the spoken line matches the screen.
Zoom crops make small UI legible: menu text is about 20-25 px and typed lines 36-52 px at 720p.
Claude is shown as a participant with an orange flag and caret, then the closing line is typed by 'Claude' and 'You' flags, so the product's metaphor becomes the tagline.
Restrained palette: blue ground, cream page, one clay accent; the logo ends on a still frame held about 5 s.
Self-checking beat: asking Claude 'is this right?' shows an honest 'Mostly.' with For and Against, which builds trust in a way a success shot would not.

weak.observation: Full-window shots shrink body and chart text to about 10 px, below phone legibility, and the chat panel on the left is unreadable at 720p.
Final-state loudness is -17 LUFS integrated and the true peak is +0.4 dB, above the -1 dBTP ceiling; likely to clip in encoding.
Reading time is thin on long copy: the 26-word Claude reply and the 21-word summary rely on voice-over to be read.

rule_candidates.rule: In a UI walkthrough, let named cursors type the content live and animate the product itself; show a result within 10-20 s of each stated action.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0012.jpg-f0014.jpg typing by 5 named flags, t=18-22s; chart at t=52s.

rule_candidates.rule: Keep one demo in one continuous shot of 20 s or more when the action is typing: change something on screen about every 1.2 s instead of cutting every 1.8-3.5 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: 23 s shot 37.17-60.17s (27.7% of runtime); median_hold_s 1.17; median shot 4.56 s.

rule_candidates.rule: A calm walkthrough needs no 5-8 cut burst; run it at about 9 cuts a minute with every seam on a topic change.
Frame 0 can be the real product page with title and cursor already in place; the title is a single 4.3 % line, bolding the product name as the accent.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0001.jpg; ink measure t=1s: 31 px of 720.

rule_candidates.rule: Cut when the cursor lands on a control, and show the result under the still cursor, so the cause of each seam is on screen.
rule_candidates.evidence: cut at 14.54s after cursor on Team standups (strips/window-12-14.459s.jpg); cut at 37.17s.

rule_candidates.rule: Zoom to 2-4x on the one region being acted on, and pull back to the full window once to show context.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0021.jpg (zoomed) versus f0027.jpg (full window at t=52-54s).

rule_candidates.rule: Close with a tagline typed by two labelled cursors that mirror the product's collaboration, then hold the logo still for about 5 s.

rule_candidates.rule: A social master at -17 LUFS with +0.4 dBTP is a miss: this film shows what the -14 LUFS and -1 dBTP targets would have prevented.
